item.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

item.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
